create_tool_call_event_handler: create a ToolCallEventHandler instance with an EventBus and a dictionary of async tool functions
handle_tool_call_event: handle incoming TOOL_CALL events by executing registered functions and publishing TOOL_RESULT events back to the bus
run_function: run a named function with keyword arguments and a call ID, supporting async functions, async generators, and sync returns
subscribe_to_tool_call_events: subscribe the ToolCallEventHandler to TOOL_CALL events on the event bus during initialization
publish_tool_result: publish a TOOL_RESULT event with a FunctionResponse including id, name, and INTERRUPT scheduling to the event bus
